loweredBecause: J3 demoted CASE-0185 from raster-visual to structural-visual because its check opens the G17 dump rather than a picture — the claim was to pixels the case never had. Only effect rungs count, so removing a false pixel claim costs one checked case: 98 to 97. This is the honest direction. The alternative was to keep a raster-visual case whose artifact is a JSON manifest, which is the exact defect J3 was dispatched to fix, and it would have held the bar at 98 by leaving the suite knowing less.
